dag_infos.description: New Taipei City resident marital status counts by age band and gender, from the New Taipei gender-statistics open dataset. The 15-19 and 35-39 bands cross the fixed 18-35 youth boundary, so youth conversion is apportioned rather than exact.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市現住人口婚姻狀況（按年齡別、性別）
data_infos.source_type: 新北市資料開放平臺 data.ntpc.gov.tw
data_infos.dataset_description: 資料集提供2000至2024年新北市現住人口按年齡別、婚姻狀況及性別的計數，另含同性婚姻子項。DAG保留來源的年齡組與合計列，行政區層級為新北市全市65000。
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch page=0,size=5000 until an empty page, always with a browser User-Agent. Normalize itemvalueN and item valueN aliases by role, parse age labels into integer bounds, and raise on an unknown label. Emit total/male/female source cells once; same-sex fields are separate subset indicators and must not be added to primary marital-status totals. Reconcile every source cell and assert each primary status total equals its male plus female components. A yearly all-population total is checked against the other-year median; a more-than-threefold scale change raises instead of entering the database. The 18-35 classification is apportioned because 15-19 and 35-39 cross the boundary; no rate or population scaling is applied in ETL.
